message.content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "[R68]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports their 3 year old can play the game.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "It’s cute, my 3 year old is able to do a few levels no problem they can get tricky as time goes on."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R73]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the game is ugly, boring, and the controls are terrible.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I don’t understand the positive reviews.  The underlying premise of this game is basically to throw legos randomly into place in any manner that approximates a path, regardless of whether they are supported from below, fit together well structurally, or express anything meaningful or artful.  It barely qualifies as a puzzle.  It’s ugly, boring, and the controls are terrible."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R74]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports they felt scammed because progress reset and they couldn’t understand the game.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "It’s a great game overall, with a cute idea. That much I like. However, placing blocks in story mode is just so too difficult. I couldn’t get past the beginning of story mode, so I checked out creative mode. There, I couldn’t understand what to do. So I went back to story mode, but all my progress reset. And I never got to do anything that I saw here. So I simply gave up."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R75]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports feeling lonely while playing the game.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "So I was playing this for like ten minutes and I was already feeling sad and lonely. I don’t know if that was the intention or not but it is still how I feel when I play it."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R76]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports trying to control piece placement on a phone gave them a headache.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Trying to control the piece placement on a phone gave me a headache."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R77]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the story is enticing and they felt like they were on the journey with the characters.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "The story line that goes along about the little Lego and the big Lego was also a huge hit for me , it was enticing and by the time I finished the game I felt like I was on the journey with them."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R78]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports they paid for the game via Apple Arcade and felt disappointed by the limited levels.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Really fun and enjoyable game but not nearly enough levels! I downloaded this and only got 2 evenings and mornings of play before my only option is creative mode or replaying the story. It was fun, I was looking forward to following these little Lego dudes through a wild “journey” which was more like a walk around town. Disappointed, as this is a game I have to pay to be able to play, via Apple Arcade."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R84]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports moving pieces around on mobile is difficult.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "moving the pieces around in mobile is a bit difficult."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R85]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports difficulty zooming in and rotating the level 360 degrees.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The inability to zoom in closer.  The lighting is quite odd on several levels and it’s very difficult to see what pieces are even available.  I don’t have terrible vision but I feel like my eyes are strained many times trying to see what I’m working with.  The inability to rotate the level 360 degrees.  Many other games that remind me of this one will allow you the flip the view around however you want, which would make this more fun and less frustrating."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R89]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports selecting where to move parts is extremely difficult and unplayable.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "selecting the place where you want to move is extremely difficult . Unplayable bc of that , ruins everything when you can’t do properly the only way of interaction in the game."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R95]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the controls are inconsistent and frustrating.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Controls are so inconsistent is just not worth sticking with."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R96]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports finishing the game in 2 days and feeling it ended too quickly.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The game is amazing but I finished it in 2 days.that is way to fast for a game."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R97]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the game felt like a short demo and they were not prepared to be done so quickly.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "It felt like I had downloaded a free demo waiting for the “if you’d like to continue, purchase the full game for $9.99.”"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R100]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the game is too short and begs for more levels.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This is a very awesome puzzle game.   The only “complaint” I have… and really is more of a suggestion or compliment…. It is tooooo short of a game…. PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE create more levels!!!!!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R101]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A reviewer begs for more levels, saying they want to play more.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Need more! Love the game🙏🏼"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R102]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the controls are absolutely frustrating and drive them away.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Controls are absolutely frustrating and drives me away from playing the game."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R103]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports they beat the game and love the ending, calling it one of the greatest games of all time.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This game makes me so happy! I beat the game and I love it! I love Legos and I love this game too! It makes me super happy, especially the ending!this is one of the greatest games of all time!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R104]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the block snaps into the wrong place when held.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The block looks like it’s line up you hold to put it in place and it snaps it in to the wrong place, one click over, things like that."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R105]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports it is very hard to line up the bricks, nearly impossible.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "It’s very hard to line up the bricks nearly impossible"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R106]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the storyline was confusing and they wish for more levels.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The game is amazing but I finished it in 2 days.that is way to fast for a game. I loved everything else. The storyline was a bit confusing I didn’t understand what the dad was doing at a factory I wanna say. If someone could explain that it would be great."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R107]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A young player reports they and their dad both liked the game.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "I am quite young but I really liked this game and so did my dad"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R108]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the game has an implicit story and masterfully exposes plot and gameplay.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This is an excellent game with an implicit story and built-in tutorial that masterfully exposes the plot and gameplay elements in a well-paced fashion."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R109]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the controls are awkward and difficult to place blocks.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Good puzzles, but somehow they managed to make the controls awkward. It is difficult to get the blocks into place."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R110]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A reviewer mentions they thought Minecraft would be part of the game.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Good game! I thought that Minecraft would be apart of this."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R111]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the game is excellent but needs more levels.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Excellent, but needs more levels"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R112]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports no zoom and lack of 120hz makes brick placement tedious.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "not being able to zoom makes brick placement extremely tedious, so much that instead of relaxing me I become frustrated."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R113]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A reviewer asks how to request more levels, saying they would love to see more stories.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This game is perfect. I was so disappointed when I hit the end. I would LOVE to see more stories/levels added to the game. I could play this forever."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R114]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A reviewer calls the game criminally short and says it should be longer.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This game is beautiful, I loved every second of it, but it’s not nearly as long as it should be."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R115]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A reviewer begs for more levels, saying they played it twice and want more.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Please, I’m literally begging for more!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R116]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports they completed the game three times and wish for more levels.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I’ve completed the game three times and I wish there was more."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R117]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A reviewer calls the game one of the most well designed Lego games they’ve played.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "One of the most well designed Lego game I’ve played yet"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R118]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports they loved the puzzles and the journey through the Lego world.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This game was not like any other game you play, it walks you through this Lego world with so many different challenges and puzzles to figure out."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R119]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the controls are terrible and the tutorial didn’t explain where to press and hold to place.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Click the piece you want to pick up, drag to move it, then click again to rotate, and hold to place- except half the time it’ll either rotate the piece again or drop it or even pick up a new piece? 🤷‍♀️ It never said WHERE to press and hold to place in the tutorial so I don’t know if there’s a special place you have to press but that control just doesn’t work."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R120]",
      "area": "controls",
      "claim": "A reviewer reports the controls are awful and they cannot place blocks reliably.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Please tune these controls. They’re awful. I literally just tried to place a block 5 times in a row but dropped it each time instead."
    }
  ]
}
